subject: Invoice intake: portal-first policy, email exceptions, and mixed-PO sample

Subject: Vendor onboarding question: mixed-PO invoices and portal exceptions

Hi Sean,

We are onboarding a partner (Kestrel Labs) that will deliver invoices which sometimes bundle multiple PO numbers in a single PDF or CSV. Our standard is portal-first, but Kestrel has limited SSO capability and asked whether they can email AP instead.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood confirm the preferred intake path for vendors who cannot adopt the portal? Portal-first, with an email fallback? Any special subject tokens or attachment naming we should request?
- Could you share a sample CSV (or mapping rules) that supports multiple PO lines per invoice and how Redwood expects multi-PO rows to be represented?

I attached a small sample from Kestrel for reference. Also please let me know if you need our vendor setup form completed before we accept emailed invoices.

Thanks,

Lumina Health

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding question: mixed-PO invoices and portal exceptions

Priya —

On Tue, Jun 9, 2026 at 08:14 AM Priya Singh <priya@luminahealth.com> wrote:
> We are onboarding a partner (Kestrel Labs) that will deliver invoices which sometimes bundle multiple PO numbers in a single PDF or CSV.

Thanks for the example — helpful. Our stance at Redwood for enterprise customers is: portal-first, email fallback with strict structure. Quick summary of what we recommend for Lumina so we can make onboarding repeatable:

1) Portal-first: preferred for idempotency, line-item parsing, and immediate acks.
2) Email fallback: allowed when the vendor cannot adopt the portal. When using email, require a structured CSV (preferred) or a clearly labeled PDF + a minimal header in the subject line so our ingestion engine can route and ack correctly.

Minimum CSV conventions (attached sample):
- invoice_id (string)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number (multiple rows allowed per invoice_id; each row is one PO-line)
- line_description
- quantity
- unit_price (decimal)
- currency
- vendor_tax_id
- remit_entity_code (if you have multiple Lumina entities)

Filename + subject token:
- filename: LUMINA_<vendor>_<invoice_id>_<date>.csv
- email subject: "LUMINA-INVOICE [vendor=KestrelLabs] [invoice_id=INV-123]"

Ack / SLA: our system returns an automatic acknowledgment within 12 hours for valid CSVs and flags malformed files for manual review (expected manual ack within 48 hours). For portal submissions acks are immediate.

Vendor setup: we do need a completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (attached) for new vendors before we enable auto-posting to payables. For email fallback, Ops will accept invoices prior to full form completion on a case-by-case basis but require a PO-stamp policy (see below).

PO stamping policy suggestion (for Lumina):
- If invoice total > $5,000, require PO-stamp on the invoice or PO lines present in the CSV.
- For <$5,000, allow non-PO submissions but flag for PO reconciliation.

I attached a small CSV example (mixed-po-csv-example.csv) that demonstrates multiple PO rows per invoice_id. Can you confirm whether Lumina needs any additional columns (cost center, tax codes) and whether you want us to enforce a different filename/subject token?

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mixed-po-csv-example.csv (csv, 3 KB)]
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]

This looks good and aligns with our internal expectations. A couple clarifications before we send Kestrel the onboarding checklist:
- Lumina requires PO stamping for invoices > $5,000 — confirmed.
- We would like the subject token to include the entity code because we route by entity: e.g. "LUMINA-INVOICE [entity=LH-CA] [vendor=KestrelLabs] [invoice_id=INV-123]"
- Can your auto-ack include a short parse result in the ack (e.g., total_amount, number_of_po_lines, parse_status)? That would help our AP queue.

If you can update the sample CSV with an extra entity_code column and include a sample ack payload in the docs, we can proceed. Also please send over the vendor_onboarding_form link for signature and we'll coordinate DocuSign on our side.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Priya Singh
Accounts Payable
Lumina Health
